definition.vi: OS-managed execution instance có virtual address space và resource/security context theo hệ điều hành.
definition.en: An OS-managed execution instance with an address space and resource or security context.

example.vi: Hai server processes có thể isolate heaps và giao tiếp qua IPC/socket.
example.en: Two server processes can have separate heaps and communicate through IPC.

pitfall.vi: Isolation không tuyệt đối: shared memory, inherited handles và common kernel/resources vẫn tồn tại.
pitfall.en: Shared memory, handles, kernels and resources can cross the isolation boundary.

definition.vi: Execution stream được schedule trong một process, thường chia sẻ address space với threads cùng process.
definition.en: A scheduled execution stream commonly sharing its process address space.

example.vi: Worker threads có stacks riêng nhưng có thể truy cập shared heap state.
example.en: Worker threads have separate stacks but may access shared heap state.

pitfall.vi: Concurrency không đồng nghĩa parallelism; shared memory cần synchronization và visibility rules.
pitfall.en: Concurrency does not imply parallelism; memory sharing needs synchronization.

definition.vi: Address abstraction ánh xạ process-visible virtual addresses tới physical/storage-backed mappings theo OS policy.
definition.en: An address abstraction mapping virtual addresses to physical or storage-backed mappings.

example.vi: Page tables giúp các processes dùng cùng virtual addresses mà map tới physical pages khác nhau.
example.en: Processes can use identical virtual addresses mapped to different physical pages.

pitfall.vi: Không chỉ swap hoặc infinite RAM; page faults, permissions và working set ảnh hưởng performance.
pitfall.en: It is not simply swap or infinite RAM; faults and working sets affect performance.

definition.vi: Chuyển CPU execution context giữa scheduled tasks, lưu/khôi phục state cần thiết.
definition.en: Switch CPU execution between scheduled tasks by saving and restoring required state.

example.vi: Scheduler chuyển từ blocked worker sang runnable worker khác.
example.en: A scheduler switches from a blocked worker to a runnable one.

pitfall.vi: Cost gồm cache/TLB effects tùy situation; quá nhiều threads không tự tăng throughput.
pitfall.en: Cache and TLB effects vary; more threads do not automatically improve throughput.

definition.vi: Kết quả phụ thuộc timing/interleaving không được kiểm soát giữa concurrent operations.
definition.en: A result depends on uncontrolled timing or interleaving among operations.

example.vi: Hai workers cùng đọc available=1 rồi cùng decrement có thể oversell nếu check/write không atomic.
example.en: Two workers can oversell after both observe one available unit.

pitfall.vi: Không chỉ data race trong memory; distributed check-then-act cũng có race dù từng process single-threaded.
pitfall.en: It extends beyond memory races; distributed check-then-act can race in single-threaded processes.

definition.vi: Synchronization primitive cấp exclusive access cho critical section theo ownership rules.
definition.en: A synchronization primitive granting exclusive access to a critical section.

example.vi: Protect shared in-process queue mutation bằng một mutex.
example.en: Protect a shared in-process queue mutation with a mutex.

pitfall.vi: Không tự bảo vệ across processes/hosts hoặc giữ invariant khi code khác bỏ qua lock; deadlocks vẫn có thể xảy ra.
pitfall.en: It does not automatically protect remote processes or code bypassing the lock.

definition.vi: Counter-based synchronization primitive giới hạn permits cho concurrent work hoặc signal availability.
definition.en: A permit-count synchronization primitive bounding concurrency or signaling availability.

example.vi: Semaphore có 20 permits giới hạn tối đa 20 active downstream calls trong scope của nó.
example.en: A twenty-permit semaphore bounds active calls within its scope.

pitfall.vi: Không phải requests-per-second limiter; release leaks, cancellation và cross-host scope cần xử lý.
pitfall.en: It is not a per-second limiter; permit leaks and scope matter.

definition.vi: Một tập operations không thể tiến triển vì mỗi bên chờ resource/event mà bên khác trong tập giữ hoặc chưa thể phát.
definition.en: A set of operations cannot progress because of circularly dependent resource or event waits.

example.vi: Thread 1 giữ lock A và chờ B, trong khi thread 2 giữ B và chờ A.
example.en: One thread holds A waiting for B while another holds B waiting for A.

pitfall.vi: Timeout có thể giúp recovery nhưng không giữ correctness tự động; lock ordering và transaction retries cần design.
pitfall.en: Timeouts can aid recovery but do not establish correctness.

definition.vi: Git object ghi tree snapshot, parents và metadata; commit ID content-addressed theo object format.
definition.en: An object recording a tree snapshot, parents and metadata under Git's content-addressed format.

example.vi: Branch ref trỏ tới commit; commit parent links tạo history graph.
example.en: A branch reference points to a commit whose parent links form history.

pitfall.vi: Commit không đồng nghĩa đã push/deploy; secrets đã commit không được xử lý chỉ bằng xóa file ở commit sau.
pitfall.en: A commit is not a push or deployment; later deletion does not remove leaked secrets from history.

definition.vi: Kết hợp histories bằng merge operation, có thể fast-forward hoặc tạo merge commit theo graph/options.
definition.en: Combine histories through fast-forward or a merge commit according to the graph and options.

example.vi: Merge feature vào main giữ parent relationship nếu tạo merge commit.
example.en: A merge commit preserves parent relationships between histories.

pitfall.vi: Conflict resolved không chứng minh business behavior đúng; cần review và checks sau merge.
pitfall.en: Resolving textual conflicts does not prove behavior is correct.

definition.vi: Replay selected commits lên base khác, thường tạo commit identities mới.
definition.en: Replay selected commits onto another base, generally creating new commit identities.

example.vi: Feature branch có thể rebase lên updated main trước integration theo team policy.
example.en: A feature branch can be rebased onto updated main under team policy.

pitfall.vi: Rewrite shared history cần phối hợp; force-with-lease chỉ là ref guard, không thay review hoặc backup.
pitfall.en: Shared-history rewriting needs coordination; lease-guarded pushes do not replace review.

definition.vi: Tạo commit mới đảo intended patch effects của commit trước theo current context.
definition.en: Create a new commit reversing a prior commit's patch effects in the current context.

example.vi: Revert published faulty change giữ history thay vì xóa branch commits.
example.en: Reverting a published change preserves history.

pitfall.vi: Không rollback external DB/data effects hoặc erase history; merge reverts có parent semantics riêng.
pitfall.en: It does not reverse external effects or erase history; merge reverts need parent semantics.

definition.vi: Continuous Integration kiểm changes thường xuyên; Continuous Delivery/Deployment tự động hóa release pipeline với mức approval khác nhau.
definition.en: Continuous integration checks changes frequently; delivery or deployment automates release pipelines with differing approval policies.

example.vi: Pipeline lint/test/build artifact rồi deploy exact artifact sau gates.
example.en: A pipeline checks, builds and deploys the exact gated artifact.

pitfall.vi: Green build chưa chứng minh production deploy success; credentials, environments và rollback cần visibility riêng.
pitfall.en: A green build is not proof of successful deployment; environments and rollback need visibility.

definition.vi: Process isolation/resource packaging dựa trên host kernel mechanisms và runtime configuration.
definition.en: Process isolation and packaging using host-kernel mechanisms and runtime configuration.

example.vi: Image khởi tạo processes với namespaces/cgroups theo runtime policy.
example.en: An image starts processes under runtime isolation and resource policies.

pitfall.vi: Không mặc định VM/security sandbox hoàn chỉnh; kernel sharing, privileges và mounts ảnh hưởng isolation.
pitfall.en: It is not automatically a complete VM or security sandbox; privileges and mounts matter.

definition.vi: Artifact chứa filesystem layers và config để runtime tạo container theo platform/manifest.
definition.en: An artifact of filesystem layers and configuration used to create a container.

example.vi: Pin digest để deploy cùng image content thay vì mutable latest tag.
example.en: Pin a digest to deploy the same image content instead of a mutable tag.

pitfall.vi: Digest stability không chứng minh image safe hoặc reproducible build; scan, provenance và secrets handling vẫn cần.
pitfall.en: A stable digest does not prove safety or reproducibility.

definition.vi: Orchestration platform dùng declarative APIs/controllers để quản lý workloads và resources.
definition.en: An orchestration platform using declarative APIs and controllers to manage workloads and resources.

example.vi: Deployment controller reconcile desired replicas với observed cluster state.
example.en: A Deployment controller reconciles desired replicas with observed state.

pitfall.vi: Không tự làm application highly available, secure hay database consistent; architecture và operation vẫn quyết định.
pitfall.en: It does not automatically make applications available, secure or consistent.

definition.vi: Kubernetes scheduling unit chứa một hoặc nhiều colocated containers cùng shared networking và defined volumes.
definition.en: A scheduling unit containing colocated containers with shared networking and defined volumes.

example.vi: App và tightly coupled sidecar có thể ở cùng Pod khi lifecycle cần gắn nhau.
example.en: An application and tightly coupled sidecar can share a Pod.

pitfall.vi: Pod identity/placement có thể mất khi replacement; không dùng local container filesystem làm durable database mặc định.
pitfall.en: Pod replacement changes identity and placement; local files are not automatically durable storage.

definition.vi: Controller resource quản lý ReplicaSets và rollout của thường là interchangeable Pods.
definition.en: A controller resource managing ReplicaSets and rollouts of generally interchangeable Pods.

example.vi: Rolling update điều chỉnh old/new ReplicaSets theo surge/unavailable policy.
example.en: A rolling update changes old and new ReplicaSets under surge and unavailability policies.

pitfall.vi: Rollout success không chứng minh app correctness; readiness, migrations và version compatibility cần kiểm.
pitfall.en: Rollout success does not prove correctness; migrations and compatibility need checks.

definition.vi: Workload controller cung cấp stable ordinal identities và per-Pod storage associations theo configuration.
definition.en: A workload controller providing stable ordinal identities and configured per-Pod storage associations.

example.vi: Database operator có thể dùng StatefulSet để gắn ordinal member với PVC riêng.
example.en: A database operator can associate ordinal members with separate claims.

pitfall.vi: Không tự cung cấp replication/consensus/backup; storage deletion và failover vẫn theo policies.
pitfall.en: It does not itself provide replication, consensus or backups.

definition.vi: API abstraction expose nhóm eligible endpoints qua service discovery/networking semantics.
definition.en: An abstraction exposing eligible endpoints through service discovery and networking semantics.

example.vi: ClusterIP Service cung cấp stable virtual access cho matching backend endpoints.
example.en: A ClusterIP Service offers stable virtual access to matching endpoints.

pitfall.vi: Không bảo đảm immediate endpoint propagation, session affinity hoặc global load balance; proxy/dataplane config ảnh hưởng.
pitfall.en: Propagation and balancing behavior depend on dataplane configuration.

definition.vi: Liveness kiểm restart eligibility, readiness kiểm traffic eligibility, startup bảo vệ giai đoạn initialization theo kubelet rules.
definition.en: Liveness concerns restart decisions, readiness traffic eligibility and startup initialization protection.

example.vi: App đang warmup có thể fail readiness mà không bị restart nếu liveness vẫn healthy.
example.en: An initializing application can fail readiness while remaining live.

pitfall.vi: Liveness phụ thuộc fragile downstream có thể gây restart storm; probe success không chứng minh mọi business flow healthy.
pitfall.en: Fragile dependency checks can cause restart storms; probes do not prove every flow healthy.

definition.vi: Requests tham gia resource scheduling; limits đặt runtime enforcement cho resources theo implementation.
definition.en: Requests inform scheduling; limits configure runtime resource enforcement.

example.vi: CPU limit có thể throttle work; memory limit có thể dẫn tới OOM termination khi vượt.
example.en: CPU limits can throttle work, while memory excess can lead to OOM termination.

pitfall.vi: Không phải mọi resource enforce giống nhau; requests/limits không thay app-level admission hoặc latency measurement.
pitfall.en: Resources are enforced differently; these settings do not replace admission control.

definition.vi: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler điều chỉnh desired replica count từ configured metrics và scaling policies.
definition.en: A controller adjusting desired replica counts from metrics and scaling policies.

example.vi: HPA có thể scale workload theo CPU utilization hoặc custom queue metric.
example.en: It can scale using CPU utilization or custom queue metrics.

pitfall.vi: Không provision nodes tự động hoặc xóa warmup/downstream bottlenecks; metric delay và stabilization cần tune.
pitfall.en: It does not itself provision nodes or remove warmup and downstream bottlenecks.

definition.vi: Request của workload cho storage với capacity/access mode/class theo Kubernetes volume binding.
definition.en: A workload request for storage under volume capacity, access and class binding rules.

example.vi: Pod mount volume được provision/bind qua PVC và storage driver phù hợp.
example.en: A Pod mounts a volume bound or provisioned through a claim and driver.

pitfall.vi: Persistent không có nghĩa backup, multiwriter safety hoặc survive mọi failure; reclaim/retention và storage contract cần rõ.
pitfall.en: Persistence does not imply backups, safe multiwriting or survival of every failure.

definition.vi: Role-Based Access Control gán permissions qua roles và bindings cho principals trong scopes.
definition.en: Assign permissions to principals through roles and bindings within scopes.

example.vi: Service account chỉ được read một resource set cần thiết thay vì cluster-admin.
example.en: A service account reads only necessary resources rather than using cluster-admin.

pitfall.vi: Role names không đủ đánh giá quyền; wildcard, aggregation, bindings và privilege escalation paths cần kiểm.
pitfall.en: Role names alone do not reveal effective privileges or escalation paths.

definition.vi: Khai báo hoặc lập trình infrastructure desired state để version, review và apply qua tools.
definition.en: Describe desired infrastructure as versioned, reviewable code applied through tools.

example.vi: Plan resource changes và review diff trước apply bằng scoped credentials.
example.en: Review a resource plan before applying it with scoped credentials.

pitfall.vi: Code không tự loại drift hoặc secrets; state files, destructive diffs và provider behavior cần bảo vệ.
pitfall.en: Code does not eliminate drift or secrets; state and destructive changes need controls.
